news.title: Paul Tudor Jones calls bitcoin the 'best inflation hedge,' warns of overvalued stocks
news.summary: It will be "really hard to make money" in stocks over the next decade, said the billionaire investor, noting that the S&P 500's valuation reminds him of the 2000 dot-com bubble.
